expert_review_roles.responsibility: Prove that GLUE rejection is a typed evidence transition and that CANNOT_CHECK can never be coerced into rejection.
Keep the v1/v2 routers and canonical audit unchanged; make the successor additive and preserve immutable transformation memory.
Attack composition order, episode revision, target/context, witness content, missing evidence, incomplete candidate accounting and negative-history retention.
Freeze before implementation, compare with strongest fair parents, preserve prior negatives and stop promotion on any unearned shortcut.

atomic_gap: Permit LIFT only after every structurally viable GLUE composition is either accepted or individually, conclusively, content-bound rejected; unresolved or merely malformed composition evidence must remain CANNOT_CHECK.

successor_contract.issuance_rule: A composition certificate is minted only inside the resolver after the unchanged canonical GLUE audit returns FAIL for the exact composition review and every audit reason is in the registered conclusive allowlist.
binding: GLUE candidate key derived from the exact episode set
successor_contract.memory_rule: Rejecting one composition does not delete its component episodes because they may participate in other compositions. Canonical memory is unchanged; only the exact composition candidate is marked rejected by certificate.
successor_contract.uncertainty_rule: Missing witness, CANNOT_CHECK, malformed/nonconclusive FAIL, or an unaccounted GLUE candidate blocks LIFT and remains CANNOT_CHECK.
successor_contract.lift_rule: LIFT may be attempted only when every GLUE candidate key in the bound memory is covered by a valid composition rejection certificate and the existing ExhaustionWitness plus MissingTransformationSpecification pass the unchanged canonical audit.
successor_contract.negative_history_rule: Every certified GLUE rejection remains in the returned resolution trace alongside any prior SEARCH/JUMP rejection certificates.
successor_contract.authority: routing/proposal only; no theorem, novelty, scientific or model-efficacy authority
